flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanLettersGeneratorJob,jobs/ToppanUploadJob,helpers/ToppanUploadHelper,models/ToppanStage}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findToppanNoticesForStage), framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl (fixed-width file format), framework/services/comcryptSftpBlob/helper/ComcryptUploadProcessor + utilities/sftpComponent/SftpUtil (SFTP delivery, blocked by config), application-{dev,uat,prod}.properties, cron-schedules-prod.properties. Other repos: no code specific to this story.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%), demo_remark about SFTP and App Service permission. The Toppan Upload cron at 00:15 (enabled in prod) runs every stage including RD2: it selects notices, fills the address, builds a fixed-width data file (named URA-DPT-RD2-D1-<timestamp>), puts it in Azure Blob and requests COMCRYPT encryption to send it to the Toppan SFTP. The file generator and the notice selection are shared by all Toppan stages (same as RD1 in OCMS11.7), with no RD2-specific logic apart from the stage name and the next stage RR3. The core of the story (the file reaching the vendor) is blocked by config: sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in dev, uat and prod (application-prod.properties:86). While the block is active the delivery gate is bypassed and the stage still advances to RR3 even though the file was not delivered, so a notice status can say the 2nd letter was sent when it was not. Only the data file format exists for RD2; PDF is generated for ANL only. Toppan service, COMCRYPT, SFTP, letter wording, and App Service permission: cannot verify from repo. Tickets used: OCMS-DF-2026-170 (Closed, admin fee and origin of the SFTP block), OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT, stage advances while the block is active).
recommendation: Partial claim: RD2 file generation and the stage update exist, but SFTP delivery to the vendor is blocked by config and the stage still advances while the block is active. Ask URA when the block is lifted

steps.step: A daily job creates and sends the 2nd letter reminder file (stage RD2) to the vendor
steps.detail: The Toppan Upload cron runs at 00:15 and is enabled in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62). ToppanLettersGeneratorJob loops over all ToppanStage values in order (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151-166); RD2 = 'Reminder 2' with next stage RR3 and 14 days (ToppanStage.java:19-25). Delivery to the vendor is assessed in step 6. Double check: the 00:15 schedule (process_dayend_jobs) exists and is enabled, but the call to toppanLettersGeneratorService.executeJob() in ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.executeDayEndJobs (line 119) is commented out, so letter generation only runs through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters. Rated Partial.

steps.step: OCMS selects the NOPOs that qualify for the 2nd letter reminder
steps.detail: The findToppanNoticesForStage query with stage RD2: next_processing_stage = 'RD2', next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type NULL, offender_indicator 'Y' (the current offender, including a hirer), not an Advisory Notice (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:584-614), called from ToppanUploadHelper.java:1887 through ToppanUploadJob.java:248. Foreign vehicles (vehicle_registration_type F) without PS-FOR are excluded and get PS-FOR (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1935-1965).

steps.step: The letter address comes from the latest hirer particulars (letter_address) and notices without an address are skipped
steps.detail: Notices are enriched with addresses by priority (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2020-2023), notices without a deliverable address are dropped (F-17, 2026-2050), then only those with letter_address = 'Y' continue (filterByLetterAddress, 2372-2400; called in ToppanUploadJob.java:266). The particulars themselves come from the MHA/DataHive update (see OCMS11.31). Same logic as RD1 (OCMS11.7).

steps.step: OCMS builds the data file (PDF/data format) with the letter details for the vendor to print
steps.detail: File name URA-DPT-RD2-D1-<timestamp> (ToppanUploadJob.java:278-281); the content is built through createRequestFileContent('TOPPAN_RD2') (ToppanUploadJob.java:286-287, AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:78-90), which calls createToppanRequestFileContent: header 'H' + date/time, fixed-width 719-character detail 'D' lines (letter date, notice no, name, address, vehicle no, place and rule infringed), trailer 'T', sorted by postal code, NRIC deliberately left blank (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:564-603, 648-700). The same generator is used by all Toppan stages, so there is no RD2-specific format in the repo. A PDF is only generated for ANL (ToppanUploadJob.java:324), so the 2nd letter is a data file, matching the story's 'PDF/data files'. The RD2 letter wording printed by the vendor: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The file is saved to Azure Blob and encrypted through COMCRYPT for delivery to the vendor
steps.detail: The original file is uploaded to Azure Blob (uploadToBlob, ToppanUploadJob.java:311-316), then comcryptTokenHelper.requestToken requests encryption (346-353); the COMCRYPT callback that puts the encrypted file on SFTP is assessed in step 6. The COMCRYPT service and its encryption result: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The file is sent to the vendor (Toppan) through SFTP
steps.detail: The delivery code exists (COMCRYPT callback then SFTP), but sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in prod, uat and dev (application-prod.properties:86; application-uat.properties:77; application-dev.properties:77). SftpUtil.isServerUploadDisabled (SftpUtil.java:111-113) makes ComcryptUploadProcessor throw SftpDisabledException and keep the operation record (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:206-209), so the RD2 file does not reach Toppan while this property is set. OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT) says this block was put in place under OCMS-DF-2026-170 (Closed) and covers the job failing while the block is active. Whether the block is lifted in Azure prod and real delivery to the Toppan SFTP: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: After delivery, the NOPO moves to the next stage (RR3) and is recorded as sent the 2nd letter
steps.detail: After delivery is confirmed, updateProcessingStage sets last stage RD2, next stage RR3 + 14 days (from ocms_stage_map and the STAGEDAY parameter, falling back to the ToppanStage.RD2 enum), amount_payable, and administration_fee 0 for stages other than RR3/DR3 (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1366-1421, 1810-1847; fix OCMS-DF-2026-170). Partial because the delivery gate is bypassed while SFTP is blocked (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-446): the stage still advances to RR3 and the notice is treated as sent the 2nd letter although the file was not delivered, so a notice can move on to the Final Reminder without a 2nd letter. OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT, not in prod) still covers this behaviour.
